search_window.basis: End of last reported completed hourly check through the current observation; fresh reporting may be indexed with delay.

categories_checked: Loss, closure, fire, or disaster affecting only/sole/last/full-service community grocery
Cancellation/suspension of emergency food distribution after weather, outage, or facility damage
Abrupt food-pantry or food-bank closure or major loss of service
Official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance disruption with immediate access consequences
bounded_query_context: Oct 20-21 2026 official SNAP/WIC EBT outages or benefit interruptions
coverage_notes.screening_notes: Excluded September rural grocery closures, September storm-affected food bank, older SNAP notices, October 14 advance notice of a two-day Oct 20/22 routine Decatur pantry closure, and earlier-known Oct 25 Austin food co-op closure (not sole store). No newly published, independently supported qualifying U.S. disruption verified within observation window.
coverage_notes.limitation: Bounded searches cannot establish nationwide absence; delayed indexing and direct notices outside indexed web coverage remain possible.
coverage_notes.exclusions: Out-of-window/previously known incidents, scheduled minor closures, nonsole grocery closure, donation appeals, resource guides, promotion, broad price stories, international items, duplicates.
